title: Gate coordinate of the witness
statement: For every Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits, every Boolean input $w$, and every gate $i$ of $C$, the quadratic witness of $C$ at $w$, evaluated at the coordinate assigned to gate $i$, equals the element of the field with two elements corresponding to the Boolean value of gate $i$ on input $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits
